reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: §10(a) is a broad Vendor defend/indemnify/hold-harmless obligation covering Claims arising out of the Services, the Auction Platform, Kubient's breach of any representation or warranty, and Kubient's (and its subcontractors') acts or omissions, with no infringement carve-outs.

The IP head is captured both by the 'arising out of the Services / Auction Platform' language and by the §9(b)(i) non-infringement warranty being an indemnified breach; breach-of-law, data-security and misconduct heads flow through the warranty package as described.

§11 supplies standard indemnification procedure (notice not a condition precedent, indemnitor control of defence/settlement with no liability admission against us, cooperation at indemnitor's cost), and §7(a) exempts indemnification from the consequential-damages exclusion, so recovery is not sub-capped — at or above the preferred position.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was applied (rendered text is identical to the original) and no counterparty comment was proposed; the deterministic check for a Vendor IP indemnity passes.

Correctly treats the broader Customer-side indemnity in §10(b) and the knowledge-qualified Creative head as noted sub-elements rather than flagging them here, avoiding double-flagging and unnecessary reopening of an acceptable clause.
